title: Projection-compatible finite evaluations of the direct-image Roos object
statement: For a chosen SfIntegralDirectImage object and an isomorphism from the total derived coefficient limit to it, there are finite evaluation isomorphisms whose composites with the actual total-limit projections equal the corresponding Roos projections.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21; Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23--24; Stacks Tag 0941.

proof.text: Normalize the whole-system direct image by lem-weil-system-direct-image-reduction-normalized. Choose a coefficient calculus on Y and apply unrestricted normalized reconstruction. Its counit-projection equation makes the scalar-extension adjunct q_n of every actual total-limit projection invertible. By lem-weil-sf-direct-image-roos-finite-reduction the scalar-extension adjunct r_n of the specified Roos projection is also invertible, without completeness of K. Define a_n=q_n^{-1} followed by scalar extension of the given e and then r_n. Cancel q_n; naturality of the scalar adjunction on both variables gives exactly the displayed actual projection equation.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 3.5.4--3.5.7 and 6.5.11(3); the finite-adjunction cancellation proof and arbitrary-e transport are written by B7.

lean.statement:
theorem systemDirectImage_roosEvaluation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [(integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).Additive]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (coefficientSequenceModules l E X)]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    [HasProduct (sfDirectImageTerm l E f K)]
    (L : SfIntegralDirectImage l E f K)
    (e : (coefficientSequenceLimit l E Y).obj
      ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        (S.reduction.obj K)) ≅ L.obj) :
    ∃ a : ∀ n : ℕ, (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj
        ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          (S.reduction.obj K)) ≅ sfFiniteDerivedDirectImage l E f K n,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (coefficientSequenceProjection l E Y n).app
            ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
              (S.reduction.obj K)) ≫
          (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map (a n).hom =
        e.hom ≫ L.projection ≫ Pi.π (sfDirectImageTerm l E f K) n
